description: Don't tell me sky is the limit when there are footprints on the moon ☾.
summary: An illustrated digital storybook designed for school-age space enthusiasts that brings to life NASA's dormant hardware left on the Moon, Mars, and deep space. By translating historical mission data into an engaging narrative, the project connects the engineering of silent robotic pioneers—from Apollo landers to Mars rovers—to the groundbreaking scientific discoveries they made possible
details: Many young learners hear about active space missions, while the historic machines resting silently across the solar system remain hidden in dense technical archives. The Sleeping Sentinels of Space is an accessible, 7-slide visual narrative built in Canva for school-age students and casual space fans. It takes readers on a journey across the Moon, Mars, and interstellar space to meet the Apollo Lunar Modules and Lunar Roving Vehicles, the Viking landers, the Spirit and Opportunity rovers, the Ingenuity helicopter, NEAR Shoemaker, and Pioneer 10 and 11—showing how each machine operated and why its legacy still shapes space exploration today. AI Disclosure: A large language model (Gemini) was used to help brainstorm the narrative structure and draft the story text for this presentation.
